name: CLEAN 15.4.3 RECONSOLIDATION
changes: Rebuilds from the stable 15.4.3 production release and keeps its protected admin email and Nova Poshta delivery automation
Transfers verified later fixes directly into their owning component files without global mobile override stylesheets
Clears an applied promo whenever the cart becomes empty, after a successful order, after invalidation, or after a bound email changes
Clears stale promo text and input state in the current page instead of only removing sessionStorage
Keeps every discounted order payable at a minimum of 1 UAH in cart, promo validation, order creation and the atomic database guard
Makes free-delivery progress, selected delivery method and order summary use one shared shipping state
Restores the established 15.4 gallery zoom and adds decoded atomic switching plus rapid-click protection against first-image flashes
Reduces the product breadcrumb-to-gallery gap to 20 px on desktop and 10 px on mobile
Allows useful text selection while keeping buttons and navigation non-selectable
Keeps card payment bank-controlled in admin and removes the manual paid quick action
Keeps admin autofill dark, article table labels readable, genuine review cards stable and account order images at 4:5
Simplifies scent-guide questions and places Welcome Credit after the personal recommendations
Adds one current release journal and one RC3 verification script for regression tracking
